findings.detail: Issuer-name extraction leaked schedule category and investment terms into issuer_name instead of retaining only the Company cell.
Continuation/instrument-only rows such as the Passport Labs convertible note were parsed into issuer_name even though the source row has no company cell.

citation.quoted_text: Convertible Promissory Note A ($ 694 par, due 9/2024 ) | 3/2/2023 | 8.00 % | 8.00 % | 694 | 943 | 0.1 %

rationale: C206 is confirmed by raw source. The investment schedule has a Company column followed by separate Investment, Initial Acquisition Date, Reference Rate and Spread, Interest Rate, Amortized Cost, Fair Value, and Percentage of Net Assets columns. The cited rows show clean issuer/company cells such as IntelePeer Holdings, Inc., Passport Labs, Inc., American Achievement, Corp., Dye & Durham, Ltd., and Rapid Data GmbH Unternehmensberatung, with instrument/date/rate text in separate cells. The flagged stored issuer_name values concatenate schedule section labels and those separate investment terms, so the data field is wrong rather than the rule firing being a false alarm.
